SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS all_sets,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN TRIM(t.translation) <> '' AND TRIM(t.language) <> '' THEN s.id END) AS translated_sets,
       MIN(s.releaseDate) AS first_release, MAX(s.releaseDate) AS last_release,
       COUNT(t.id) AS translation_rows, COUNT(t.translation) AS nonnull_names,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.language) AS language_values
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS t ON t.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2016-01-01' AND s.releaseDate < '2017-01-01'

arguments.sql:
WITH languages_per_set AS (
    SELECT s.id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.language) AS language_count
    FROM sets AS s
    LEFT JOIN set_translations AS t
        ON t.setCode = s.code
       AND TRIM(t.translation) <> ''
       AND TRIM(t.language) <> ''
    WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2016-01-01'
      AND s.releaseDate < '2017-01-01'
    GROUP BY s.id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(language_count), 2) AS average_languages
FROM languages_per_set
LIMIT 1
